Author: Anand Pathak

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
 Before Lok Adalat
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Anand Pathak
 &
 Social Worker Dr. S. K. Mathur
 On The 10th Of May, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 7013 of 2025
 Omprakash Batham And Others
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Petitioners Omprakash Batham and Lakhan Batham are present 
 Prosecutrix (respondent No.2) also present in person.

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Order 
Due to call given by High Court Bar Association, Gwalior dated 8.5.2025, lawyers are abstaining from work.

2. The instant petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners for quashment of FIR in Crime No.202/2023 registered at Police Station Belgada, District Gwalior for offence under Sections 363, 366, 376(2)(n), 506, 34 of IPC and under Sections 3, 4 of POCSO Act.
3.

Petitioner No.1 Omprakash Batham bears Aadhar Card No.214201647941, petitioner No.2 Lakhan Batham bears Aadhar Card No.898668265729 and prosecutrix bears Aadhar Card No.690287097477.
4.
At the outset, prosecutrix and petitioner No.1 Omprakash Batham informed this Court that both of them entered into wedlock and both are living as legally wedded couple.

This fact has been mentioned by the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10372 2 MCRC-7013-2025 prosecutrix in her application filed under Section 320 (2) of Cr.P.C. for compounding of offence/for settlement.
An affidavit of prosecutrix is also on record in this regard.

entities.text: Omprakash Batham vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Both the parties (petitioners and prosecutrix) appeared before the Principal Registrar of this Court on 17.2.2025.
6. Principal Registrar of this Court verified the fact that both want to live together as legally wedded couple.

7. Prosecutrix herself appeared before this Court and after verifying her identity from matching the Aadhar Card Number with Aadhar Card Number filed at the time of verification before Principal Registrar of this Court, this Court came to the conclusion that identity of the prosecutrix is proper and she wants to settle the matter because she is legally wedded wife of petitioner No.1 Omprakash Batham.
8. She submits that she was major at the time of commission of offence and she left her maternal home on her own volition.
9. Fact remains that petitioner No.1 and respondent No.2 are married couple.
It is regular and easy to be retributive but at the same time a Judge has to sublimely feel the pulse of the case.
One cannot forget that "Every "F I L E" with same alphabets, contains a "L I F E".

(See : In Re State of Madhya Pradesh Vs. Pankaj Mishra, 2021 SCC OnLine MP 5480 and Geeta Paliwal and others Vs. Sitaram and others reported as 2023 SCC Online MP 811.).
10.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Geeta Paliwal and others Vs. Sitaram and others reported as 2023 SCC Online MP 811
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Considering the submissions of petitioners and prosecutrix, application along with affidavit as well as verification report submitted by Principal Registrar of this Court in peculiar facts and circumstances of the NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:10372 3 MCRC-7013-2025 case,
finality
be given to the litigation.
Resultantly, application is allowed and trial arises out of Crime No.202/2023 pending before 4th Additional Sessions Judge, Dabra, District Gwalior in Special Case No.02/2024 is hereby quashed.

entities.text: 4th Additional Sessions Judge, Dabra, District Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioners are set free.

(ANAND PATHAK) (DR. S. K.
 MEMBER MEMBE

(alok)
